exposure: Inter-twin delivery interval (<=15 min or >15 min)
outcome: Neonatal composite outcome of the second twin
Umbilical cord pH of the second twin
Base deficit of the second twin
Birth weight of the second twin
cohort: The study included 1808 cases of diamniotic twin pregnancies at >=24 weeks of gestation that underwent a trial of vaginal delivery at a single tertiary center between 2011 and 2021.
finding: The study found no significant effect of inter-twin delivery interval on the composite outcome of the second twin, but a prolonged interval was associated with lower umbilical cord pH and higher base deficit.
